hebrewText: וַ/חֲצִ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/עַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְ/אֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּ/בָּשָׁ֑ן לִ/בְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַ/חֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי מָכִ֖יר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽ/ם

tokens.kjv: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

tokens.bdb: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
tokens.kjv: Asharoth, Astaroth. See also H1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), H6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).

tokens.bdb: Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine
a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
